questions.question: Describe the method of cryopresevation.
questions.solution_html:
•  Somatic gene therapy – genes introduced into body cells; not inherited
  •  Germline gene therapy – genes introduced into gametes or embryos; heritable
  • Describe the method of cryopreservation.
  •  Selection of plant material
  •  Treatment with cryoprotectants
  •  Rapid freezing in liquid nitrogen (-196 °C)
  •  Storage
  •  Thawing and regeneration
questions.final_answer:  Thawing and regeneration
